Hi Kimberly,

I'm following up on invoice ALT_INV_9987 (due 2026-10-15) — we're in a tight cash window and I wanted to be transparent: the payment is delayed while we sort a VAT reclaim question with our European finance team. We can commit to a partial payment this week and clear the remainder by mid-December if that helps.

Thanks,

Thanks for the transparency, Aisha — appreciate it.

Short version: we can accept a staggered remit but we need a concrete schedule + VAT evidence to keep this off the escalation track. Proposed next steps from our side:

- Provide a firm partial payment (minimum 30%) by 2026-11-24.
- Provide remaining balance no later than 2026-12-15 (staggered plan acceptable with two tranches).
- Supply VAT evidence (invoice-level tax computation, local VAT registration or reverse-charge paperwork, and any bank remittance screenshots) within five business days of the partial payment.

If we don't receive the partial payment + VAT evidence by 2026-11-24 we will move to a stepped dunning sequence: reminder -> formal past-due notice -> credit committee review -> exec briefing. I'm copying Finance Ops (Laura) and Collections (Jonas, Marcus) so they can prepare the flow and materials.

Attachments: I've attached a copy of the invoice we have on file (ALT_INV_9987_copy.pdf) and a short checklist for VAT evidence.

Will you confirm whether Altitude can hit the proposed dates? If not, flag constraints and we'll try to find an alternative to escalation.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

Subject: Board briefing request: coordinated dunning sprint and VAT evidence path for Altitude Labs

Team — pulling together a short board-facing briefing and asking for a 72-hour sprint to lock treatment. Context: Altitude has made a 35% partial payment (see remittance screenshot) and supplied VAT evidence; target final is 2026-12-14. They are in EU entity mix and the VAT paperwork looks plausible but requires Finance sign-off.

What I need for a board ask (deck + one-pager) by EOD 2026-12-02:

1) Jonas — draft a two-slide collections timeline (today -> 2026-12-14) that shows the dunning steps, service risk thresholds, and proposed customer communication cadence. Include the proposed canary fallback (route API traffic to read-only keys if payment missed).
2) Marcus — prepare a one-paragraph executive summary and recommended approval (credit committee ask) with recommended credit terms if we accept staggered remit vs. immediate legal escalation. Also draft a short exec email template targeted at Altitude’s CFO/CEO.
3) Laura — confirm VAT evidence sufficiency or list outstanding docs; give a firm 'clear' or 'needs one more doc' by 2026-12-01 17:00 UTC.

Attachments I'm including: brief-deck-board-ask.pdf (starter deck) and dunning-timeline.csv (tracking template). We'll meet 2026-12-02 09:00 UTC to finalize the board slide and sign-off.

If we do not get final payment by 2026-12-14, we escalate to legal for contract enforcement and consider temporary service restriction on new feature rollouts. Keep communications tight and avoid reactive public language — this will be a controlled board briefing.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
